Do I need a Florida LLC operating agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Florida does not require you to file one, but you should have one. It sets who owns what, who makes decisions, and what happens if someone leaves.
Yes. LLC Standard and LLC Premium include an EIN from the IRS. Please do not send a Social Security number or ITIN through the website form.

mainEntity.name: What does the yearly registered agent plan include?

acceptedAnswer.text: We act as your Florida registered agent and registered office and log and forward mail the same business day. It includes 5 mail scans a year and annual report reminders at 90, 30, and 7 days.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep my home address off the public record?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The registered agent address can be the address on the public record. Official mail comes to us, and we forward it to you.

mainEntity.name: When is the Florida annual report due?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every Florida LLC files one each year, between January 1 and May 1. We remind you, and we can file it for you.
Registered agent service, plus we file your annual report each year once you confirm your information.
